def get_specifier_range_info(style: bool=True, pin_hint: bool=False) ->str:
    """
    Get information about specifier ranges.
    
    Args:
        style (bool): Whether to apply styling to the output.
        pin_hint (bool): Whether to include pinning hints.
    
    Returns:
        str: Information about specifier ranges.
    """
    base_msg = "To learn more about reporting these, specifier range handling, and options for scanning unpinned packages visit https://docs.pyup.io/docs/safety-range-specs"
    
    if pin_hint:
        base_msg = "We recommend either pinning to one of the versions above or updating your install specifier to ensure a vulnerable version cannot be installed. " + base_msg
    
    if style:
        return click.style(base_msg, bold=True, fg='green')
